title: Avoid excessive prop drilling
guideline: Use composition or context for state needed 3+ levels deep instead of drilling props

title: Be deliberate about controlled vs uncontrolled inputs
guideline: Pick one pattern per form field and stay consistent; don't flip-flop with value/defaultValue

title: Use stable keys for dynamic lists
guideline: Key list items by a stable unique id, never array index for reorderable/filterable lists

title: Minimize useEffect usage
guideline: Prefer event handlers and derived state over useEffect for logic that isn't a true side effect

title: Extract reusable logic into custom hooks
guideline: Move repeated stateful logic into a named useXyz hook rather than duplicating it

title: Don't memoize prematurely
guideline: Reach for React.memo/useMemo only after profiling shows a real re-render cost

title: Add error boundaries around risky subtrees
guideline: Wrap components that fetch external data in an ErrorBoundary with a graceful fallback

title: Keep custom interactive components accessible
guideline: When building custom dropdowns/tabs, follow WAI-ARIA authoring patterns for roles and keyboard support
